(* 1.0 SIL-3 FUNCTIONAL SAFETY & EMERGENCY VACUUM ISOLATION HARDWIRED INTERLOCKS             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Continuously evaluates hardwired SIL-3 beam tube vacuum integrity, cryogenic quench      *)
(* hazards, catastrophic air ingress, and mechanical gate valve safety barriers.             *)

dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;

(* Interlock 1.1: Active-low Emergency Shutdown Relay (SIL-3 Safety Circuit) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Loop Broken *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.2: System Master Enable Dropped *)
IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Master System Enable Permissive Lost *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.3: Catastrophic Vacuum Breach (Overpressure Exceeding Trip Threshold) *)
IF (rBeamTubePressure_A_mbar > rMaxAllowablePressure_mbar) AND
   (rBeamTubePressure_B_mbar > rMaxAllowablePressure_mbar) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Beam Tube Overpressure Vacuum Breach *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.4: Cryogenic Radiation Baffle Severe Thermal Quench (T > 135 K) *)
IF (rCryoBaffleTemp_A_K > 135.0) AND (rCryoBaffleTemp_B_K > 135.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: LN2 Cryo-Baffle Severe Thermal Quench *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.5: Sorption Cryopump Stage 2 Critical Warmup (T > 28.0 K during UHV online) *)
IF (bCryopumpA_Online OR bCryopumpB_Online) AND
   (rCryoPumpTemp_A_K > 28.0) AND (rCryoPumpTemp_B_K > 28.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Sorption Bed Desorption Pressure Burst Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.6: LN2 Phase Separator Vessel Overpressure (Exhaust Blockage Hazard) *)
IF rLN2BoilOffPressure_bar > 4.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: LN2 Cryostat Relief Overpressure Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.7: Catastrophic 4-km Beam Tube Acoustic / Seismic Excitation (> 85 dB) *)
IF (rTubeVibration_A_dB > 85.0) AND (rTubeVibration_B_dB > 85.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Extreme Beam Tube Structural Vibration Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.8: RGA Filament Emission Failure / Vacuum Arc Fault *)
IF (rRgaIonFilamentCurrent_A < 0.005) OR (rRgaIonFilamentCurrent_A > 0.065) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: RGA Ion Source Filament Arc / Open Fault *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.9: Regeneration Heater Thermal Runaway (T_heater > 425 K) *)
IF x_state[8] > 425.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Regeneration Heater Thermal Runaway Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.10: Turbomolecular Foreline Backing Overpressure (> 2.0 mbar) *)
IF rForelineRoughPressure_mbar > 2.00 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Turbopump Foreline Backing Breach Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Master Safety Trip Evaluation *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bGateValveOpenPermissive := FALSE;
    iState := 200; (* Jump immediately to Emergency Vacuum Breach Containment State *)
END_IF;

    IF ((rBeamTubePressure_A_mbar >= rBeamTubePressure_B_mbar) AND (rBeamTubePressure_A_mbar <= rBeamTubePressure_C_mbar)) OR

(* --- 2.4 Beam Tube Distributed Accelerometer 2oo3 Bank --- *)
rDev_Tube_AB := ABS(rTubeVibration_A_dB - rTubeVibration_B_dB);
rDev_Tube_BC := ABS(rTubeVibration_B_dB - rTubeVibration_C_dB);
rDev_Tube_CA := ABS(rTubeVibration_C_dB - rTubeVibration_A_dB);

bTube_A_Healthy := (rTubeVibration_A_dB >= 10.0) AND (rTubeVibration_A_dB <= 120.0);
bTube_B_Healthy := (rTubeVibration_A_dB >= 10.0) AND (rTubeVibration_A_dB <= 120.0);
bTube_C_Healthy := (rTubeVibration_A_dB >= 10.0) AND (rTubeVibration_A_dB <= 120.0);

IF bTube_A_Healthy AND bTube_B_Healthy AND bTube_C_Healthy THEN
    bTube_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bTube_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rTubeVibration_A_dB >= rTubeVibration_B_dB) AND (rTubeVibration_A_dB <= rTubeVibration_C_dB)) OR
       ((rTubeVibration_A_dB >= rTubeVibration_C_dB) AND (rTubeVibration_A_dB <= rTubeVibration_B_dB)) THEN
        rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB := rTubeVibration_A_dB;
    ELSIF ((rTubeVibration_B_dB >= rTubeVibration_A_dB) AND (rTubeVibration_B_dB <= rTubeVibration_C_dB)) OR
          ((rTubeVibration_B_dB >= rTubeVibration_C_dB) AND (rTubeVibration_B_dB <= rTubeVibration_A_dB)) THEN
        rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB := rTubeVibration_B_dB;
    ELSE
        rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB := rTubeVibration_C_dB;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Tube_AB > 6.0) OR (rDev_Tube_BC > 6.0) OR (rDev_Tube_CA > 6.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0100_0000; (* Accelerometer discrepancy *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTube_A_Healthy AND bTube_B_Healthy THEN
    bTube_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB := (rTubeVibration_A_dB + rTubeVibration_B_dB) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0200_0000;
ELSE
    rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB := rBeamTubeAcousticNoise_dB; (* Fallback to auxiliary sensor *)
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0800_0000;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (dwDegradationWord <> 16#0000_0000);


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 RESIDUAL GAS ANALYZER (RGA) 4x4 CRACKING MATRIX INVERSION & DECOUPLING                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Decouples overlapping mass spectrometer cracking patterns for H2, H2O, CO/N2, and CO2.    *)
(* Evaluates inverse cracking matrix M^-1 in real time to produce clean partial pressures.   *)

IF NOT bCrackingMatrixInverted THEN
    (* Populate Forward Calibration Cracking Matrix M (scaled by emission sensitivity) *)
    (* Column 1: Pure H2 response *)
    M_crack[1, 1] := c_Cracking_H2_at_Mass2 * rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.85; (* H2 at Mass 2 *)
    M_crack[2, 1] := 0.0;
    M_crack[3, 1] := 0.0;
    M_crack[4, 1] := 0.0;

    (* Column 2: Pure H2O response *)
    M_crack[1, 2] := c_Cracking_H2O_at_Mass2 * rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.00;  (* Dissociation H2+ from H2O *)
    M_crack[2, 2] := c_Cracking_H2O_at_Mass17 * rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.00; (* Hydroxyl OH+ from H2O *)
    M_crack[3, 2] := 0.0;
    M_crack[4, 2] := 0.0;

    (* Column 3: Pure CO / N2 response *)
    M_crack[1, 3] := 0.0;
    M_crack[2, 3] := 0.0;
    M_crack[3, 3] := c_Cracking_CO_at_Mass28 * rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.00;  (* CO+/N2+ at Mass 28 *)
    M_crack[4, 3] := 0.0;

    (* Column 4: Pure CO2 response *)
    M_crack[1, 4] := 0.0;
    M_crack[2, 4] := 0.0;
    M_crack[3, 4] := c_Cracking_CO2_at_Mass28 * rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.35; (* CO+ fragment from CO2 *)
    M_crack[4, 4] := c_Cracking_CO2_at_Mass44 * rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.35; (* CO2+ parent at Mass 44 *)

    (* Analytical Inversion of Upper-Triangular Structured Matrix M *)
    (* M is block-triangular; inversion proceeds via forward-backward substitution *)
    rDet_M := M_crack[1, 1] * M_crack[2, 2] * M_crack[3, 3] * M_crack[4, 4];
    
    IF ABS(rDet_M) > 1.0E-28 THEN
        (* Diagonal terms: reciprocal of forward coefficients *)
        M_inv[1, 1] := 1.0 / M_crack[1, 1];
        M_inv[2, 2] := 1.0 / M_crack[2, 2];
        M_inv[3, 3] := 1.0 / M_crack[3, 3];
        M_inv[4, 4] := 1.0 / M_crack[4, 4];

        (* Off-diagonal decoupling terms *)
        M_inv[1, 2] := -M_crack[1, 2] / (M_crack[1, 1] * M_crack[2, 2]);
        M_inv[1, 3] := 0.0;
        M_inv[1, 4] := 0.0;

        M_inv[2, 1] := 0.0;
        M_inv[2, 3] := 0.0;
        M_inv[2, 4] := 0.0;

        M_inv[3, 1] := 0.0;
        M_inv[3, 2] := 0.0;
        M_inv[3, 4] := -M_crack[3, 4] / (M_crack[3, 3] * M_crack[4, 4]);

        M_inv[4, 1] := 0.0;
        M_inv[4, 2] := 0.0;
        M_inv[4, 3] := 0.0;

        bCrackingMatrixInverted := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Form Measured Ion Current Vector (gain and background corrected) *)
I_meas[1] := MAX(0.0, (rRgaRawCurrent_Mass2_A * rRgaGainCorrection) - 1.0E-14);
I_meas[2] := MAX(0.0, (rRgaRawCurrent_Mass17_A * rRgaGainCorrection) - 1.0E-14);
I_meas[3] := MAX(0.0, (rRgaRawCurrent_Mass28_A * rRgaGainCorrection) - 1.0E-14);
I_meas[4] := MAX(0.0, (rRgaRawCurrent_Mass44_A * rRgaGainCorrection) - 1.0E-14);

(* Matrix-Vector Multiplication: P_decoupled = M_inv * I_meas *)
IF bCrackingMatrixInverted THEN
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
        P_decoupled[iRow] := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            P_decoupled[iRow] := P_decoupled[iRow] + (M_inv[iRow, iCol] * I_meas[iCol]);
        END_FOR;
        (* Enforce physical non-negativity constraint *)
        P_decoupled[iRow] := MAX(1.0E-14, P_decoupled[iRow]);
    END_FOR;

    rDecoupledH2_PartialPressure_mbar  := P_decoupled[1];
    rDecoupledH2O_PartialPressure_mbar := P_decoupled[2];
    rDecoupledCO_PartialPressure_mbar  := P_decoupled[3];
    rDecoupledCO2_PartialPressure_mbar := P_decoupled[4];
ELSE
    (* Fallback approximate uncoupled estimation *)
    rDecoupledH2_PartialPressure_mbar  := I_meas[1] / (rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.85);
    rDecoupledH2O_PartialPressure_mbar := I_meas[2] / (rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 0.235);
    rDecoupledCO_PartialPressure_mbar  := I_meas[3] / (rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.00);
    rDecoupledCO2_PartialPressure_mbar := I_meas[4] / (rRgaEmissionSensitivity * 1.35);
END_IF;

(* Optical Residual Gas Phase Noise Metric on Interferometer Laser *)
(* Index alpha_polarizability: H2 = 0.8e-24, H2O = 1.45e-24, CO2 = 2.65e-24 *)
rInterferometerPhaseNoiseIndex := (rDecoupledH2_PartialPressure_mbar * 0.80) +
                                  (rDecoupledH2O_PartialPressure_mbar * 1.45) +
                                  (rDecoupledCO_PartialPressure_mbar * 1.95) +
                                  (rDecoupledCO2_PartialPressure_mbar * 2.65);
rInterferometerPhaseNoiseIndex := rInterferometerPhaseNoiseIndex * 1.0E+09; (* Scaled index *)


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 DUBININ-RADUSHKEVICH SORPTION ISOTHERM & CHARCOAL BED CAPACITY KINETICS               *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates thermodynamic saturation state of coconut-shell activated carbon matrix at      *)
(* cryogenic temperatures (10 K - 20 K). Computes adsorption Polanyi potential & loading.    *)

(* Hydrogen saturated vapor pressure approximation at Stage 2 operating temperature *)
IF rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K < 14.0 THEN
    rSaturatedVaporPress_H2_mbar := 85.0 + ((rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K - 10.0) * 45.0);
ELSIF rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K < 20.0 THEN
    rSaturatedVaporPress_H2_mbar := 265.0 + ((rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K - 14.0) * 124.0);
ELSE
    rSaturatedVaporPress_H2_mbar := 1013.0;
END_IF;

(* Polanyi Adsorption Potential: epsilon = R * T * ln(P_sat / P) *)
(* In UHV, ratio P_sat / P is large; bounded log approximation avoids numerical overflow *)
IF rDecoupledH2_PartialPressure_mbar > 1.0E-14 THEN
    rAdsorptionPolanyiPotential_E := c_IdealGas_R * rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K *
        LN(MAX(1.0, rSaturatedVaporPress_H2_mbar / rDecoupledH2_PartialPressure_mbar));
ELSE
    rAdsorptionPolanyiPotential_E := c_IdealGas_R * rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K * 28.5;
END_IF;

(* Dubinin-Radushkevich Sorption Capacity: W = W0 * exp( -B * (epsilon / beta)^2 ) *)
(* Dimensionless loading exponent calculation *)
rCalculatedSorptionCapacity := c_W0_MaxCapacity_mbarL * c_CharcoalMass_g *
    EXP(-MIN(25.0, c_B_AffinityParameter * (rAdsorptionPolanyiPotential_E / c_Beta_Affinity_H2) *
                                           (rAdsorptionPolanyiPotential_E / c_Beta_Affinity_H2)));

(* Accumulate adsorbed gas flux: Q_in = S_pump * P_H2 *)
(* Effective pumping speed for 4-km arm terminal cryopump array ~ 15,000 L/s for H2 *)
rHydrogenAdsorptionRate_mbarLs := 15000.0 * rDecoupledH2_PartialPressure_mbar;
rAccumulatedHydrogenLoad_mbarL := rAccumulatedHydrogenLoad_mbarL +
    (rHydrogenAdsorptionRate_mbarLs * rScanSamplePeriod_s);

(* Real-Time Bed Saturation Percentage *)
IF rCalculatedSorptionCapacity > 10.0 THEN
    rCharcoalH2Saturation_pct := (rAccumulatedHydrogenLoad_mbarL / rCalculatedSorptionCapacity) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCharcoalH2Saturation_pct := 99.9;
END_IF;
rCharcoalH2Saturation_pct := MIN(100.0, MAX(0.0, rCharcoalH2Saturation_pct));

(* Breakthrough Proximity Warning *)
bCharcoalSaturationWarning := (rCharcoalH2Saturation_pct >= rMaxCharcoalSaturation_pct);
IF bCharcoalSaturationWarning THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Sorption charcoal capacity warning *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 4-KM BEAM TUBE ACOUSTIC WAVE MODAL FILTERING & ANTI-PHASE ACTIVE DAMPING              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Mitigates laser scattered light phase noise by damping structural breathing eigenmodes     *)
(* (f0 = 37.5 Hz) along the corrugated stainless steel 4-km beam tube stations.              *)

IF bAcousticDampingEnable AND NOT bSystemTripped THEN
    (* Direct Form II Digital Biquad Bandpass Filter Execution *)
    (* Difference equation: w[n] = x[n] - a1*w[n-1] - a2*w[n-2] *)
    (*                      y[n] = b0*w[n] + b1*w[n-1] + b2*w[n-2] *)
    rFilteredAcousticSignal_V := (rBeamTubePiezoInput_V) - (a1_filt * w1_filt_DE) - (a2_filt * w2_filt_DE);
    rAcousticVelocity_mms := (b0_filt * rFilteredAcousticSignal_V) + (b1_filt * w1_filt_DE) + (b2_filt * w2_filt_DE);
    
    (* State delay update *)
    w2_filt_DE := w1_filt_DE;
    w1_filt_DE := rFilteredAcousticSignal_V;

    (* Anti-Phase Viscous Force Demand Synthesis: F_damping = -C_visc * v_wall *)
    rRawDamperCommand_A := -rDamperVelocityGain * rAcousticVelocity_mms * rVoiceCoilGain_ApV;
    
    (* Hard voice-coil thermal protection current limiting (-3.5 A to +3.5 A) *)
    rRawDamperCommand_A := MIN(3.50, MAX(-3.50, rRawDamperCommand_A));
    
    (* Dynamic Acoustic Attenuation Ratio Calculation *)
    IF rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB > 20.0 THEN
        rAcousticSuppressionRatio_dB := MAX(0.0, 26.5 - (ABS(rAcousticVelocity_mms) * 3.8));
    ELSE
        rAcousticSuppressionRatio_dB := 28.0;
    END_IF;

    bAcousticDampingActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rRawDamperCommand_A := 0.0;
    w1_filt_DE := 0.0;
    w2_filt_DE := 0.0;
    rAcousticSuppressionRatio_dB := 0.0;
    bAcousticDampingActive := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 LN2 CRYO-BAFFLE THERMAL RADIATION SHIELDING & FLOW LEVEL REGULATION                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Controls subcooled liquid nitrogen flow through the 77 K copper chevron baffles to         *)
(* intercept 300 K blackbody thermal photon flux and cryocondense beam tube water vapor.     *)

(* Stefan-Boltzmann Radiant Heat Load Calculation *)
(* q_rad = sigma * ((1/eps_wall + 1/eps_baffle - 1)^-1) * (T_tube^4 - T_baffle^4) *)
rRadiantHeatFlux_Wm2 := rStefanBoltzmann_sigma * 0.142 *
    (8.1E+09 - (rVotedBaffleTemp_K * rVotedBaffleTemp_K * rVotedBaffleTemp_K * rVotedBaffleTemp_K));
rRadiantHeatFlux_Wm2 := MAX(5.0, rRadiantHeatFlux_Wm2);

rRadiantHeatPower_W := rRadiantHeatFlux_Wm2 * rBaffleArea_m2;

(* Equivalent LN2 Boil-Off Consumption Rate [L/h] *)
(* dm/dt = Q_rad / h_fg  ==>  dV/dt = (Q_rad / h_fg) / rho_LN2 * 3600 *)
rLN2BoilOffRate_Lh := (rRadiantHeatPower_W / rLN2EnthalpyVap_Jkg) / rLN2Density_kgL * 3600.0;

(* Liquid Nitrogen Proportional Coolant Valve Demand Closed-Loop Modulation *)
IF NOT bSystemTripped THEN
    IF rVotedBaffleTemp_K > (rTargetBaffleTemp_K + 0.50) THEN
        (* Throttling up to cool down baffle and replenish dewar *)
        rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 35.0 + ((rVotedBaffleTemp_K - rTargetBaffleTemp_K) * 8.5) +
                                   ((65.0 - rLN2SeparatorLevel_pct) * 0.65);
    ELSIF rVotedBaffleTemp_K < (rTargetBaffleTemp_K - 0.50) THEN
        (* Backing off to prevent overcooling / thermal contraction stress *)
        rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 15.0 + ((rLN2SeparatorLevel_pct - 50.0) * 0.35);
    ELSE
        (* Nominal steady-state maintaining flow *)
        rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 25.0 + (rLN2BoilOffRate_Lh * 1.25);
    END_IF;
    rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := MIN(100.0, MAX(5.0, rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct));
    bCryoBaffleChilled := (rVotedBaffleTemp_K <= 82.0);
ELSE
    rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
    bCryoBaffleChilled := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 8-STATE MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Implements complete state-space matrices (A, B, C, D) and projected gradient descent      *)
(* quadratic programming optimization to simultaneously govern thermal and vacuum variables. *)

IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Initialize Discrete State Transition Matrix A (8x8, Ts = 0.020 s) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 8 DO
            A_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
            C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        A_mat[iRow, iRow] := 0.9850; (* Stable diagonal decay *)
        C_mat[iRow, iRow] := 1.0000; (* Identity observation *)
    END_FOR;
    
    (* Physical cross-coupling state transitions *)
    A_mat[1, 1] := 0.9920; (* Baffle thermal inertia *)
    A_mat[1, 7] := -0.0125; (* LN2 dewar level cooling effect on baffle *)
    A_mat[2, 2] := 0.9950; (* Cryopump stage 2 thermal time constant *)
    A_mat[2, 8] := 0.0085; (* Regeneration heater thermal conduction to stage 2 *)
    A_mat[3, 3] := 0.9800; (* H2 partial pressure decay (sorption pumping) *)
    A_mat[3, 2] := 0.0150; (* Thermal desorption of H2 as stage 2 warms *)
    A_mat[3, 5] := 0.0220; (* Saturation loading slows pumping speed *)
    A_mat[4, 4] := 0.9750; (* H2O partial pressure decay (baffle condensation) *)
    A_mat[4, 1] := 0.0180; (* Thermal desorption of H2O as baffle warms *)
    A_mat[5, 5] := 0.9990; (* Sorbent charcoal loading accumulation *)
    A_mat[5, 3] := 0.0045; (* Hydrogen influx increases bed saturation *)
    A_mat[6, 6] := 0.9200; (* Acoustic vibration mechanical damping decay *)
    A_mat[7, 7] := 0.9960; (* LN2 phase separator level mass balance *)
    A_mat[7, 1] := -0.0035; (* Heat load boil-off level reduction *)
    A_mat[8, 8] := 0.9880; (* Regeneration heater core thermal decay *)

    (* Initialize Discrete Input Coupling Matrix B (8x6) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            B_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
            D_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    B_mat[1, 1] := -0.0450; (* u1 (LN2 valve) cools Baffle x1 *)
    B_mat[2, 2] := -0.0380; (* u2 (Pulse-tube compressor) cools Stage 2 x2 *)
    B_mat[8, 3] := 0.0650;  (* u3 (Regen heater) heats Heater core x8 *)
    B_mat[6, 4] := -0.0820; (* u4 (Voice-coil current) damps acoustic modal vel x6 *)
    B_mat[3, 5] := -0.0250; (* u5 (Turbo valve) evacuates desorbed H2 x3 *)
    B_mat[4, 5] := -0.0180; (* u5 (Turbo valve) evacuates desorbed H2O x4 *)
    B_mat[3, 6] := 0.0120;  (* u6 (N2 purge) flushes residual gas x3 *)
    B_mat[7, 1] := 0.0550;  (* u1 (LN2 valve) fills dewar level x7 *)

    (* MPC Quadratic Penalty Diagonal Weights *)
    Q_diag[1] := 12.0; (* Baffle temp tracking weight *)
    Q_diag[2] := 25.0; (* Stage 2 temp tracking weight *)
    Q_diag[3] := 85.0; (* H2 partial pressure reduction weight *)
    Q_diag[4] := 95.0; (* H2O partial pressure reduction weight *)
    Q_diag[5] := 35.0; (* Sorbent saturation minimization weight *)
    Q_diag[6] := 50.0; (* Beam tube acoustic vibration suppression weight *)
    Q_diag[7] := 8.0;  (* LN2 level regulation weight *)
    Q_diag[8] := 5.0;  (* Heater core temperature weight *)

    R_diag[1] := 1.5;  (* LN2 valve rate penalty *)
    R_diag[2] := 2.0;  (* Cryocooler rate penalty *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.8;  (* Heater power rate penalty *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.5;  (* Voice-coil rate penalty *)
    R_diag[5] := 1.2;  (* Turbo valve rate penalty *)
    R_diag[6] := 1.0;  (* Purge valve rate penalty *)

    S_diag[1] := 0.1;  (* Actuator effort weights *)
    S_diag[2] := 0.1;
    S_diag[3] := 0.05;
    S_diag[4] := 0.02;
    S_diag[5] := 0.1;
    S_diag[6] := 0.1;

    (* Actuator Hard Saturation Bounds *)
    u_min[1] := 0.0;    u_max[1] := 100.0;  (* LN2 Valve % *)
    u_min[2] := 0.0;    u_max[2] := 100.0;  (* Cryocooler % *)
    u_min[3] := 0.0;    u_max[3] := 750.0;  (* Regen Heater W *)
    u_min[4] := -3.5;   u_max[4] := 3.5;    (* Damper Current A *)
    u_min[5] := 0.0;    u_max[5] := 100.0;  (* Turbo Valve % *)
    u_min[6] := 0.0;    u_max[6] := 100.0;  (* N2 Purge Valve % *)

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Update State Vector x_state from Voted Physical Sensors *)
x_state[1] := rVotedBaffleTemp_K;
x_state[2] := rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K;
x_state[3] := LOG(MAX(1.0E-14, rDecoupledH2_PartialPressure_mbar));
x_state[4] := LOG(MAX(1.0E-14, rDecoupledH2O_PartialPressure_mbar));
x_state[5] := rCharcoalH2Saturation_pct / 100.0;
x_state[6] := rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB;
x_state[7] := rLN2SeparatorLevel_pct;
x_state[8] := MAX(10.0, x_state[8]); (* Internal heater core observer *)

(* Update Reference Vector x_ref *)
x_ref[1] := rTargetBaffleTemp_K;
x_ref[2] := rTargetCryoPumpTemp_K;
x_ref[3] := LOG(MAX(1.0E-14, rTargetBasePressure_mbar * 0.85));
x_ref[4] := LOG(MAX(1.0E-14, rTargetBasePressure_mbar * 0.10));
x_ref[5] := 0.0; (* Target zero charcoal saturation *)
x_ref[6] := 25.0; (* Baseline quiet acoustic level [dB] *)
x_ref[7] := 70.0; (* Target 70% LN2 dewar level *)
x_ref[8] := 20.0; (* Idle heater core temp *)

(* Compute Tracking Error Vector x_err = x_state - x_ref *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
    x_err[iRow] := x_state[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent MPC Optimizer (5 iterations per cycle) *)
IF bMpcOptimizationEnable AND NOT bSystemTripped THEN
    bMpcSolverActive := TRUE;

    (* Evaluate One-Step State Prediction: x_pred = A*x + B*u *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
        x_pred[iRow] := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 8 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + (A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            x_pred[iRow] := x_pred[iRow] + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_mpc[iCol]);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Optimization Iteration Loop *)
    FOR iIter := 1 TO 5 DO
        (* Evaluate Cost Gradient: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_ref) + R * (u - u_prev) + S * u *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            grad_J[iCol] := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
                grad_J[iCol] := grad_J[iCol] + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * (x_pred[iRow] - x_ref[iRow]));
            END_FOR;
            grad_J[iCol] := grad_J[iCol] + (R_diag[iCol] * (u_mpc[iCol] - u_prev[iCol])) + (S_diag[iCol] * u_mpc[iCol]);
            
            (* Projected Gradient Step *)
            u_mpc[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol] - (rStepSize * grad_J[iCol]);
            
            (* Actuator Box Saturation Projection *)
            u_mpc[iCol] := MIN(u_max[iCol], MAX(u_min[iCol], u_mpc[iCol]));
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Store previous inputs for slew penalty *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        u_prev[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Map MPC outputs to actuator targets *)
    rCryocoolerSpeedDemand_pct := u_mpc[2];
    IF iRegenState_A > 0 OR iRegenState_B > 0 THEN
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := u_mpc[3];
        rTurboForelineValve_pct := u_mpc[5];
        rPureN2PurgeValve_pct := u_mpc[6];
    ELSE
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := 0.0;
        rTurboForelineValve_pct := 0.0;
        rPureN2PurgeValve_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bMpcSolverActive := FALSE;
    rCryocoolerSpeedDemand_pct := 85.0; (* Standard baseline speed *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 PRIMARY SUPERVISORY FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Manages full lifecycle from rough vacuum pump-down to ultra-high vacuum gravitational     *)
(* wave observation mode, cryopump bumpless array swap, and emergency containment.          *)

tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#7200S);
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED STANDBY & PRE-FLIGHT VERIFICATION *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bGateValveOpenPermissive := FALSE;
        rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rCryocoolerSpeedDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := 0.0;
        rAcousticDamperCurrent_A := 0.0;

        IF bEnableSystem AND NOT bSystemTripped THEN
            IF (rForelineRoughPressure_mbar < 0.050) AND (rTurboPumpSpeed_m3s > 1.20) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Proceed to pre-evacuation foreline check *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: BEAM TUBE PRE-EVACUATION & FORELINE STABILIZATION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bGateValveOpenPermissive := FALSE;
        (* Verify auxiliary turbomolecular roughing stations established < 1.0e-3 mbar *)
        IF rVotedTubePressure_mbar < 1.0E-03 THEN
            iState := 20; (* Proceed to LN2 cryo-baffle chilldown *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: LN2 CRYO-BAFFLE CONTROLLED CHILLDOWN *)
        (* Ramp LN2 coolant flow to chill chevron baffles to 77 K without thermal stress *)
        rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 45.0;
        tBaffleChillTimer(IN := (rVotedBaffleTemp_K <= 80.0), PT := T#300S);
        
        IF tBaffleChillTimer.Q THEN
            tBaffleChillTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30; (* Proceed to cryopump stage 2 pulldown *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: SORPTION CRYOPUMP PULSE-TUBE PULLDOWN *)
        (* Energize pulse-tube cryocooler to chill stage 2 charcoal bed to < 12 K *)
        rCryocoolerSpeedDemand_pct := 100.0;
        tCryoPulldownTimer(IN := (rVotedCryoPumpTemp_K <= 12.5), PT := T#600S);
        
        IF tCryoPulldownTimer.Q THEN
            tCryoPulldownTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bSorptionStageChilled := TRUE;
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to 1200-mm gate valve equalization *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: 1200-MM ARM GATE VALVE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE EQUALIZATION *)
        (* Validate pressure across gate valve barrier before unlatching seal *)
        IF (rVotedTubePressure_mbar < 5.0E-07) AND bCryoBaffleChilled AND bSorptionStageChilled THEN
            tGateValveEqualizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
            IF tGateValveEqualizeTimer.Q THEN
                tGateValveEqualizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
                bGateValveOpenPermissive := TRUE;
                bSystemReady := TRUE;
                iState := 50; (* Transition to online GW observation mode *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tGateValveEqualizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: OBSERVATORY ONLINE - GRAVITATIONAL WAVE OBSERVATION RUN *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bGateValveOpenPermissive := TRUE;
        
        (* In observation mode: active acoustic damping, MPC governor, RGA decoupling *)
        rAcousticDamperCurrent_A := rRawDamperCommand_A;
        
        (* Monitor charcoal saturation capacity *)
        IF bCharcoalSaturationWarning THEN
            iState := 60; (* Initiate bumpless array handover *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: REGENERATION ARRAY HANDOVER PREPARATION *)
        (* Synchronize standby cryopump to identical thermal state before swap *)
        IF bCryopumpA_Online AND bRegenPermissivePumpB THEN
            (* Pump A is online; verify Pump B is cold and qualified *)
            iState := 70; (* Execute bumpless transfer *)
        ELSIF bCryopumpB_Online AND bRegenPermissivePumpA THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: PUMP ARRAY BUMPLESS LOAD TRANSFER *)
        (* Open standby pump gate valve while online pump remains active (parallel pumping) *)
        (* Once standby pump establishes base pressure, isolate saturated pump *)
        IF bCryopumpA_Online THEN
            bCryopumpA_Online := FALSE;
            bCryopumpB_Online := TRUE;
            iRegenState_A := 1; (* Launch autonomous regeneration on Pump A *)
        ELSE
            bCryopumpB_Online := FALSE;
            bCryopumpA_Online := TRUE;
            iRegenState_B := 1; (* Launch autonomous regeneration on Pump B *)
        END_IF;
        iState := 50; (* Return primary FSM to normal observation mode *)

    120: (* STATE 120: BEAM TUBE SEISMIC & ACOUSTIC DISTURBANCE OVERRIDE *)
        (* Extreme environmental wind/storm: boost voice-coil damping gain *)
        rAcousticDamperCurrent_A := MIN(3.5, rRawDamperCommand_A * 1.45);
        IF rVotedTubeAcoustic_dB < (rMaxAcousticNoise_dB - 10.0) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Return to standard observation *)
        END_IF;

    200: (* STATE 200: EMERGENCY VACUUM BREACH CONTAINMENT (SIL-3 SHUTDOWN) *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bGateValveOpenPermissive := FALSE; (* SLAM SHUT all 1200-mm gate valves in < 15 ms *)
        rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rCryocoolerSpeedDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := 0.0;
        rAcousticDamperCurrent_A := 0.0;
        rTurboForelineValve_pct := 0.0;
        rPureN2PurgeValve_pct := 0.0;

        IF bResetFaults AND NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
            IF (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#0000_0000) AND (dwAlarmWord2 = 16#0000_0000) THEN
                bSystemTripped := FALSE;
                iState := 0; (* Reset back to standby *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    210: (* STATE 210: CRYOGENIC QUENCH PRESSURE RELIEF VENTING *)
        bGateValveOpenPermissive := FALSE;
        rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
        (* Cryostat relief vents open; wait for thermal stabilization *)
        IF rLN2BoilOffPressure_bar < 1.20 THEN
            iState := 200;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 9.0 SORPTION CRYOPUMP AUTONOMOUS THERMAL REGENERATION ENGINE (PUMPS A & B)                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Dedicated independent state machines managing thermal ramp desorption (10 K -> 320 K),   *)
(* high-vacuum bakeout soak, dry N2 purge, and cryogenic recooling for dual pump arrays.     *)

(* --- 9.1 CRYOPUMP ARRAY A REGENERATION STATE MACHINE --- *)
CASE iRegenState_A OF
    0: (* REGEN IDLE / ONLINE OBSERVATION *)
        bRegenerationActivePumpA := FALSE;

    1: (* REGEN STEP 1: ISOLATION & FORELINE VACUUM TEST *)
        bRegenerationActivePumpA := TRUE;
        rTurboForelineValve_pct := 100.0; (* Open roughing bypass valve to turbopump *)
        IF rForelineRoughPressure_mbar < 0.010 THEN
            iRegenState_A := 2; (* Proceed to thermal ramp *)
        END_IF;

    2: (* REGEN STEP 2: CONTROLLED ELECTRIC THERMAL DESORPTION RAMP (0.5 K/min) *)
        bRegenerationActivePumpA := TRUE;
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := 350.0; (* Apply heating to desorb H2 from charcoal *)
        tRegenRampTimer_A(IN := (x_state[8] >= 320.0), PT := T#1800S);
        
        IF tRegenRampTimer_A.Q THEN
            tRegenRampTimer_A(IN := FALSE);
            iRegenState_A := 3; (* Proceed to bakeout soak *)
        END_IF;

    3: (* REGEN STEP 3: HIGH-VACUUM THERMAL BAKEOUT SOAK (360 K) *)
        bRegenerationActivePumpA := TRUE;
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := 220.0; (* Regulate at 360 K *)
        tBakeoutSoakTimer_A(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2400S);
        
        IF tBakeoutSoakTimer_A.Q THEN
            tBakeoutSoakTimer_A(IN := FALSE);
            iRegenState_A := 4; (* Proceed to dry N2 purge *)
        END_IF;

    4: (* REGEN STEP 4: ULTRA-PURE DRY N2 CRYOGENIC DESORPTION PURGE *)
        bRegenerationActivePumpA := TRUE;
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := 80.0;
        rPureN2PurgeValve_pct := 25.0; (* Inject pure N2 to strip heavy contaminants *)
        tPurgeDwellTimer_A(IN := TRUE, PT := T#600S);
        
        IF tPurgeDwellTimer_A.Q THEN
            tPurgeDwellTimer_A(IN := FALSE);
            rPureN2PurgeValve_pct := 0.0;
            iRegenState_A := 5; (* Proceed to foreline pump-down *)
        END_IF;

    5: (* REGEN STEP 5: FORELINE RESIDUAL PUMP-DOWN *)
        bRegenerationActivePumpA := TRUE;
        rRegenHeaterPower_W := 0.0; (* Heaters off *)
        IF rForelineRoughPressure_mbar < 5.0E-04 THEN
            rTurboForelineValve_pct := 0.0; (* Close roughing valve *)
            iRegenState_A := 6; (* Proceed to cryogenic recool *)
        END_IF;

    6: (* REGEN STEP 6: CRYOGENIC RECOOL TO 10 K & STANDBY QUALIFICATION *)
        bRegenerationActivePumpA := TRUE;
        rCryocoolerSpeedDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Full pulse-tube refrigeration *)
        tRecoolTimer_A(IN := (rCryoPumpTemp_A_K <= 11.5), PT := T#1200S);
        
        IF tRecoolTimer_A.Q THEN
            tRecoolTimer_A(IN := FALSE);
            rAccumulatedHydrogenLoad_mbarL := 0.0; (* Reset capacity accumulator *)
            rCharcoalH2Saturation_pct := 0.0;
            bRegenerationActivePumpA := FALSE;
            iRegenState_A := 0; (* Completed; pump is clean in cold standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;


(* --- 9.2 CRYOPUMP ARRAY B REGENERATION STATE MACHINE --- *)
CASE iRegenState_B OF

        bRegenerationActivePumpB := FALSE;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 10.0 ACTUATOR SLEW RATE LIMITING & ISA-18.2 BIT-PACKED STATUS WORDS                       *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Smooths final actuator demands to prevent cryogenic thermal shock, acoustic chattering,   *)
(* and packs operational status, trips, warnings, and sensor degradation words.              *)

(* Actuator Slew Rate Limiting on LN2 Valve Demand (max 5.0 %/s) *)
IF rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct > (rLN2ValveDemandInternal_pct + (5.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s)) THEN
    rLN2ValveDemandInternal_pct := rLN2ValveDemandInternal_pct + (5.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s);
ELSIF rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct < (rLN2ValveDemandInternal_pct - (5.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s)) THEN
    rLN2ValveDemandInternal_pct := rLN2ValveDemandInternal_pct - (5.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s);
ELSE
    rLN2ValveDemandInternal_pct := rLN2CryoValveDemand_pct;
END_IF;

(* Actuator Slew Rate Limiting on Voice-Coil Current (max 45.0 A/s) *)
IF rAcousticDamperCurrent_A > (rAcousticDamperInternal_A + (45.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s)) THEN
    rAcousticDamperInternal_A := rAcousticDamperInternal_A + (45.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s);
ELSIF rAcousticDamperCurrent_A < (rAcousticDamperInternal_A - (45.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s)) THEN
    rAcousticDamperInternal_A := rAcousticDamperInternal_A - (45.0 * rScanSamplePeriod_s);
ELSE
    rAcousticDamperInternal_A := rAcousticDamperCurrent_A;
END_IF;

(* Pack ISA-18.2 Compliant System Status Word *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF bSystemRunning THEN
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Observatory Online *)
END_IF;
IF bSystemReady THEN
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: System Pre-Flight Ready *)
END_IF;
IF bSystemTripped THEN
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Master Safety Trip *)
END_IF;
IF bCryoBaffleChilled THEN

END_IF;

END_IF;

END_IF;

END_IF;
IF bRegenerationActivePumpB THEN

END_IF;

IF rVotedTubePressure_mbar > 1.0E-09 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Base vacuum degraded > 1.0e-9 mbar *)
